trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The official description names the app and the count, but it does not specify which vehicles qualify or where to register them. Use the Scooter Bros app in game and confirm each registration until ten are recorded.
trophies.missableReason: The description is a cumulative app-registration goal with no stated limited window.
trophies.name: On the Spot
